reviews.author: keith flood
reviews.text: Larry and his team are great to work with. The project they did for me exceeded my expectations tremendously. His precision with his excavator is top notch. I appreciate how well he kept me up to date on process, timeline, and what to expect. I also appreciate his expertise and the suggestions he made to improve my project as he went. He cleared my property and dug a pond and created a driveway in less than 2 weeks start to finish with a couple of rain days. He was able to utilize the giant rocks he dug up in the new landscape which added a really nice touch. I’m looking forward to the next project I hire him for! If you are looking for a reliable, highly skilled professional that is easy to talk with and work with then Moser Contracting Company is the team for you. Give him a call. I’ll add some photos and come back once the pond fills for some more.

reviews.author: Martin West
reviews.text: Larry is truly exceptional. Having dealt with numerous contractors over the years, ranging from terrible to satisfactory, encountering someone as skilled and reliable as Larry is a rare find. Across several projects, including grading, waterproofing, and walkway jobs, Larry consistently impressed me with his upfront approach, extensive knowledge, punctuality, and overall professionalism. His trustworthiness is unmatched, making him one of the best contractors I've ever worked with. If you have any grading, demo, driveway, or landscaping projects, I strongly recommend reaching out to Larry, a true professional and reliable expert.

reviews.author: Catherine Bigley
reviews.text: Larry is amazing. My husband and I bought 19 acres in Gretna and 2-3 acres at the road frontage was heavily infested with kudzu. He is in the process of excavating the area and he is by far one of the best contractors we have ever worked with. He let me know about a slight change in the schedule prior to the day of. He has done an outstanding job so far both with his work and his communication. I would highly recommend him and will post before and after pictures upon completion of the job. Job is finished and it is everything we could hope for. Again, my husband and I are extremely appreciative of all the hard work and care to detail we received from Larry. We would highly recommend him. I am having technical difficulty with my pictures which are amazing, but will add as soon as possible.
